sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by a general state of mental and physical debility, with a marked loss of memory and a feeling of being divided into two personalities. It is useful in cases of nervous exhaustion and digestive disturbances. The characteristic symptom is a feeling of a plug in various parts of the body and a marked improvement of symptoms from eating.
sections.Mind: Loss of memory. Confused. Irritable. Feeling as if there were two wills, one commanding and the other forbidding. Fears. Aversion to work.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of a plug in the head. Vertigo. Scalp feels tight.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision. Sensation of a plug in the eyes.
sections.Ears: Deafness. Tinnitus. Sensation of a plug in the ears.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Sensation of a plug in the nose.
sections.Face: Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Sensation of a cobweb on the face.
sections.Mouth: Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Foul breath.
sections.Throat: Dryness and rawness in the throat. Sensation of a plug in the throat. Difficulty in swallowing.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor, but symptoms are better while eating and after eating. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Rumbling. Flatulence. Chronic constipation. Sensation of a plug in the abdomen.
sections.Rectum: Constipation. Stool large and hard. Sensation of a plug in the rectum. Much straining, even with soft stool.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of a plug in the larynx.
sections.Back: Stiffness and aching in the back. Sensitiveness of the spine to touch.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands. Numbness and tingling.
sections.Skin: Itching and burning. Dry and scaly. Eruptions like miliary rash. Intensely itching eczema.
sections.Modalities: Worse in the morning and from mental labor. Better while eating and after eating.
